text:
claire: following the OOM postmortem, opening a short thread to lock owners, measurable checkpoints, and smoke tests for the KV leak follow-ups. please add ticket links to the tracker by EOD.
omar: i'll own the allocation-profiling + nightly flamegraph artifacts. ETA: 48h for the first full-night run.
jena: i'll take GC tuning + canary gating (gc_low steps + compact-on-idle). plan: step gc_low 0.35 -> 0.45 on canary, observe 48h.
sre-lee: i'll own routing fallbacks and emergency circuit (soft-evict -> route-away) and dashboard panels for frag_ratio + alloc_slope. ETA: 3 days.
infra-bot: recurring-pattern: KV alloc spikes precede OOM by median 7m 30s across affected clusters. incidents: INC-4881, INC-4992
omar: quick profiler snippet from last run:
omar: ```
kv_alloc_hot: 31.2%
kv_insert_path: 19.8%
ref_inc_path: 9.6%
```
jena: proposed canary plan: roll GC changes to 3 nodes, run synthetic small-key churn + intermittent big writes for 6h, collect frag_ratio, kv_alloc/s, and p95/p99 every 1m. decision after 48h stable metrics.
claire: owners recap: omar=profiling+artifacts, jena=GC tuning+canary, sre-lee=routing+alerts. i'll coordinate the decision checkpoint and update the frag-ledger row with tickets and ETAs.
sre-lee: safety note: route-away early to spare pool at soft_limit=78% but cap initial route-away to 30% to avoid receiver overload; ramp if compaction reduces frag_ratio.
omar: repro harness i'll run and push artifacts to s3://frag-artifacts/canary-177777 with canary tag.
jena: GC knobs i'll try: gc_low=0.38, gc_aggressive_window=25s, compact_on_idle=true. will post exact config in the tracker.
claire: final asks: 1) owners add ticket links + ETA to the frag-ledger row; 2) post artifacts with canary tag; 3) drop a 1-line weekly status in the ledger before the decision sync. will close thread once ledger is updated. :white_check_mark:
filename_note: KV OOM follow-up owners, canary plan, and tracker asks
